description: Authoritative self-contained dataset manifest pinning historical core series, predictor series, and primary benchmark calibration forecasts.

core.csv.source_provenance: Nepal Rastra Bank (NRB) Monthly Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation reports and Central Bureau of Statistics CPI releases; harmonized Gregorian-BS reference mapping.
core.csv.license_usage_note: Research and non-commercial scientific evaluation of monetary and inflation surveillance models in Nepal.

predictors.csv.source_provenance: External macroeconomic indicators: RBI CPI, Brent crude futures, NRB foreign exchange rates, NRB balance of payments remittances, and NRB policy rate series.
predictors.csv.license_usage_note: Research and non-commercial scientific evaluation of monetary and inflation surveillance models in Nepal.

forecasts.csv.source_provenance: Empirical historical out-of-sample forecast outputs from the primary 2026-10-08 benchmark model evaluation run across Nepal macroeconomic targets.
forecasts.csv.license_usage_note: Research and non-commercial scientific evaluation of monetary and inflation surveillance models in Nepal.
